# Hosted agents gateway audit workbook
Cross-system workbook for token usage, MCP tools, denial/throttle events, latency, LLM logs, and trace lookup.

content.query: ApiManagementGatewayLlmLog | summarize TotalTokens=sum(TotalTokens) by bin(TimeGenerated, 1h), ModelName | render timechart
content.title: Token usage by model / agent dimension

content.query: let TierGenAi = union isfuzzy=true AppDependencies, AppTraces, AppRequests | extend props=todynamic(Properties) | where bag_keys(props) has_any ('gen_ai.request.model','gen_ai.response.model','gen_ai.operation.name','gen_ai.token.type') or tostring(Name) has 'gen_ai' or tostring(Message) has 'gen_ai' | extend Gateway='aigateway-tier', Model=coalesce(tostring(props['gen_ai.request.model']), tostring(props['gen_ai.response.model']), 'verify_after_live_deploy'), Tokens=todouble(coalesce(props['gen_ai.usage.total_tokens'], props['token_count'], 0)); let StandardV2 = ApiManagementGatewayLlmLog | extend Gateway='apim-standard-v2', Model=tostring(ModelName), Tokens=todouble(TotalTokens); union isfuzzy=true TierGenAi, StandardV2 | summarize Tokens=sum(Tokens), Requests=count() by Gateway, Model, bin(TimeGenerated, 1h) | render timechart
content.title: Standard v2 vs AI Gateway tier token usage

content.query: ApiManagementGatewayMCPLog | summarize Calls=count() by ToolName, ServerName | order by Calls desc
content.title: Tool calls by server and tool

content.query: union isfuzzy=true ApiManagementGatewayLogs, ApiManagementGatewayMCPLog | where ResponseCode in (401,403,429) or Error has_any ('Forbidden','throttl') | summarize Count=count() by bin(TimeGenerated, 15m), Type | render timechart
content.title: Denied and throttled

content.query: ApiManagementGatewayLogs | summarize P95=percentile(DurationMs, 95), Failures=countif(ResponseCode between (500 .. 599)) by bin(TimeGenerated, 15m), ApiId | render timechart
content.title: Gateway latency and 5xx

content.query: ApiManagementGatewayLlmLog | project TimeGenerated, CorrelationId, ModelName, PromptTokens, CompletionTokens, TotalTokens, PromptMessages, CompletionMessages | take 25
content.title: LLM log sample

content.query: let traceId = '{traceId}'; union isfuzzy=true AppRequests, AppDependencies, AppTraces, ApiManagementGatewayLogs, ApiManagementGatewayMCPLog, ApiManagementGatewayLlmLog | where tostring(OperationId) == traceId or tostring(CorrelationId) == traceId or tostring(Properties.trace_id) == traceId | order by TimeGenerated asc
content.title: End-to-end trace lookup
